createDescription: Add products to this order and everything will be delivered together.
paymentModeOrganizer: You pay for the whole order
infoNote: A group order is an order with more than one participant.
joinDescription: Add your items and the order will be delivered together.
itemsReadyDoneHint: Your selection is marked ready. You can still change items until collecting is locked.
closeJoinsHint: If closed, new people can no longer join via the invite link.
spendLimitFieldHint: Each participant cannot add items above this amount. Leave empty for no limit.
deliveryFieldHint: The delivery fee is calculated as soon as you choose a community.
leaveAsOrganizerHint: Leaving will cancel the group order for everyone
leaveConfirmBody: You will stop participating. Everyone else can keep ordering.
cancelConfirmBody: This closes the order for everyone and removes the items they added. You can't undo it.
cancelledAlert: The group order was cancelled because the group owner left.
spendLimitExceededAlert: You have reached the spending limit of {amount}. You cannot add more items.
deliverySplitHint: Delivery is split among participants who have items. Any remainder goes to the organizer.
deliveryOrganizerPaysHint: If you pay for everyone, you cover the full delivery fee.
mapTitle: Pick the address on the map
mapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to choose the exact spot.
payYouPaid: Your share is paid. Waiting for other participants.
statusAwaitingCardPayments: Waiting for the other participants to pay their shares. Then you will pay on Checkout.
payDescription: {name} — your share of the group order
payAmountHint: Amount includes your items and delivery share
payAlreadyPaidHint: Your share is confirmed. You can return to the group order.
